g.text: /frame — the hand-drawn filigree. Draw each element STRAIGHTENED along +x from its root; up = the side its end curls to.
layers: outline (filled, closed; outline-back/-mid/-front = depth) · detail (stroked: ridges) · groove (stroked: incised) · holes (closed: cut through) · guides (not built)
bodies are BENT along their slot; volutes and the shell are placed WHOLE · grey back, dark mid, black front · teal ridges, rust grooves, red holes · red bar = 1 mm
